incident-bot: :rotating_light: *INCIDENT* SEV2 opened by oncall

- Service: hosted-inference
- Symptom: elevated 5xx on /v1/chat.completions
- Region: us-east-1
- Affected pool: g4dn (T4) mixed
- Start: 1731349061
- Current: 5xx 2.8% (baseline 0.12%)
- Correlation: config change `quantization.route_enablement` @ 1731348922

Runbook: https://confluence.redwood/eng-sre/runbooks/quantization-profile-rollback-runbook

Sean Gallagher: grabbing. seeing it clustered to g4dn + only requests routed to `model=llama-3.1-70b` (hosted). h100 pool looks clean.

Rafael Mendes: :eyes: I’m on. Do we have a recent quant profile publish / enable?

Logan Wright: metrics slice shows `quant_mode=quantized` has 5xx ~7-9% on g4dn. `quant_mode=baseline` steady.

Mateo Alvarez: that smells like profile/hw mismatch not being rejected early. anyone have a sample error log?

Sean Gallagher: from one worker:
```log
E11012 17:25:41.992 runtime: request_failed req_id=rwq_6f3... status=500 err="CUDA error: no kernel image is available for execution on the device" model=llama-3.1-70b profile=qpl_llama31_70b_int8_v1.2.0 gpu=Tesla_T4 sm=75
```
(reaction: :facepalm: x2)

Hiro Tanaka: yep. that’s exactly what happens when we try to run FA2/int8 kernels that require sm80+ on sm75.

Quentin Harris: checking model registry manifest for `qpl_llama31_70b_int8_v1.2.0`… ugh it lists `supported_sm: [75, 80, 86]`. that’s wrong; should’ve been >=80 only. looks like I copied the template from the fp16 manifest.

Arjun Desai: confirm: we never validated int8 path on T4. perf suite matrix for v1.2.0 only covered A10 + A100 + H100.

Neha Kapoor: action item now is stop the bleeding. can we disable quantization on that route / model in us-east-1 quickly?

Rafael Mendes: yes. I can flip route toggle to 0% canary for hosted route group `hosted-default-chat` and force baseline. Sean ok?

Sean Gallagher: do it. I’ll also drain g4dn pool if needed but prefer config rollback first.

Rafael Mendes: pushing config change:
`rwctl routes set hosted-default-chat --quantization=disabled --reason "SEV2: g4dn sm75 incompat w/ qpl_llama31_70b_int8_v1.2.0"`

incident-bot: Change detected: `routes/hosted-default-chat quantization_enabled true -> false` by Rafael Mendes (ticket INC-7713)

Logan Wright: watching… 5xx trending down already (last 2m window 0.9% and falling). the error spikes are disappearing from `gpu_class=g4dn`.

Nadia Rahman: FYI billing tags: quantized vs baseline separation is still correct. but we’ll want to annotate dashboard that traffic got forced baseline so cost spike is expected.

Mateo Alvarez: we still need a durable fix so this can’t happen again if someone re-enables. we should hard-block at runtime when `sm < profile.min_sm` AND fallback to baseline. I think PR 28805 added exactly that?

Hiro Tanaka: +1. PR has the check + metric. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/28805
It falls back to baseline if profile/hw mismatch instead of attempting kernel load.

Connor O'Brien: I can cherry-pick 28805 into a hotfix deploy if we agree. what’s the target branch / env?

Sean Gallagher: yes please. even if we keep quant disabled for now, we need the guardrail. target prod hosted runtime in us-east-1 first.

Quentin Harris: I’ll also fix the manifest so library metadata isn’t lying. will publish `v1.2.1` with `supported_sm: [80, 86, 89, 90]` and remove 75.

Arjun Desai: before we republish, let’s add a gate in profile validation: if kernels require sm80+, schema must reflect it. we shouldn’t rely on humans.

Mateo Alvarez: agreed but immediate: (1) runtime fallback (2) corrected manifest. long-term: validation pipeline asserts `kernel_constraints` matches `hardware_scope`.

Rafael Mendes: quant disable has stabilized. current 5xx = 0.18% and dropping to baseline. keeping incident open until hotfix goes out + confirm.

Connor O'Brien: hotfix PR for cherry-pick tracking: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/28911 (cherry-pick of 28805 onto release/2024.11.12)

Sean Gallagher: :thumbsup: please include a note in release that it adds fallback + emits `quant_fallback_reason=incompatible_hardware` metric.

Logan Wright: once deployed I’ll add an alert filter so we page on `quant_fallback_reason` rising above 0.5% for any route (early warning that a profile is mis-scoped).

Neha Kapoor: make sure we capture in postmortem: mis-scoped profile allowed activation on unsupported GPU class; missing runtime guard caused 500s; config rollback worked; next steps runtime guard + validation gate + perf suite matrix requirements.

Quentin Harris: manifest fix PR in registry: `redwood-model-registry#947` (internal). will also revoke v1.2.0 for hosted (mark as "invalid_for_sm75").

Rafael Mendes: we should flush profile cache on g4dn workers? not strictly necessary since quant is disabled, but if someone flips it later, cached bad manifest might still be around.

Mateo Alvarez: good call. after hotfix lands, cache flush is safe. until then, don’t flip quant back on.

Sean Gallagher: plan:
1) keep quant disabled for hosted-default-chat
2) deploy hotfix (28911)
3) flush profile cache on us-east-1 g4dn pools
4) publish corrected profile v1.2.1 + add validation check

Connor O'Brien: deploy started to us-east-1 canary ring. ETA 15m.

incident-bot: Deploy-bot: runtime `hosted-serving` rollout started (build 2024.11.12-hotfix1) by Connor O'Brien

Logan Wright: after deploy, we should see fallback metric in place if anyone hits it, but since quant disabled it should be quiet.

Sean Gallagher: ok. leaving incident in monitoring until deploy completes + 30m clean.

incident-bot: Deploy-bot: runtime `hosted-serving` rollout completed (build 2024.11.12-hotfix1). Status: SUCCESS

Sean Gallagher: confirmed 5xx baseline for 30m, no new CUDA kernel image errors. closing SEV2, moving to postmortem.

incident-bot: Incident INC-7713 resolved by Sean Gallagher. Total duration: 1h 12m. Next: Postmortem due in 2 business days.
